subnets.subnetDescription: Real-time human judgment on breaking geopolitical events, rumors and potential misinformation. Designed for agents that cannot afford to guess when the cost of being wrong is measured in millions. Perfect for trading bots, logistics agents, risk models, and news summarizers that need fast, economically weighted truth and probability distribution.
subnets.onboardingPublishers:
To contribute raw data to this DataNet:

Submit any public source that relates to geopolitical events, flashpoints, rumors, sanctions, or potential misinformation (news articles, videos, social media posts, official statements, leaked documents, etc.).
Include the original link/source and a short description of why it might be important or suspicious.
High-quality, timely submissions are rewarded with better visibility.

We accept raw, unfiltered content. The community will then evaluate and price it.
subnets.onboardingVoters:
To vote in this DataNet:

You stake $REPPO on whether a piece of content is likely real/credible or misinformation/exaggerated.
You can also short (bet against) any submission you believe is wrong or overconfident.
Correct votes (especially strong minority views that prove right) earn rewards.
Wrong or low-conviction votes lose stake.

Your goal is to price real human conviction, not just agree with the majority. Sharp, well-reasoned takes that go against the crowd are highly rewarded.

subnets.subnetDescription: Decentralized quality scoring for AI microservice vendors routed through the Litebeam network. Vendors are scored on reliability, latency, cost-efficiency, and output quality using real transaction data with on-chain settlement hashes for verifiability.
subnets.onboardingPublishers: Submit vendor quality reports from the litebeam routing network. Each pod covers one vendor over one 48-hour epoch. Pods include: aggregate metrics (call count, success rate, latency percentiles, avg cost) and a sample of actual prompt/response pairs from real agent calls — including inline images for image generation vendors. All settlements are verifiable on-chain via Base tx hashes. Pod URL links to a rendered HTML report; JSON API URL is in the pod description. Do not fabricate data — all tx hashes are verifiable on Basescan.
subnets.onboardingVoters: Score vendor quality reports 1-10 based on: (1) Output quality — review the actual prompt/response pairs; did the vendor deliver a good result for what was asked? Look for blurry images, irrelevant search results, hallucinated data, or shallow answers; (2) Verifiability — spot-check base_tx_hash values on Basescan, confirm they correspond to real USDC settlements; (3) Data completeness — aggregate metrics present, sufficient sample size (50+ calls is strong, 5 is minimum); (4) Anomaly detection — flag impossible metrics (100% success + 0ms latency), suspiciously uniform data, or outputs that don't match the prompts; (5) Insight value — does this report reveal meaningful quality differences vs other vendors in the same category?

subnets.subnetDescription: ArAIstotle's Truth Terminal surfaces prediction market mispricings, narrative-versus-odds divergences, and emerging forecasting opportunities across global markets. Contributors and evaluators collectively build a continuously validated intelligence layer for trading systems, forecasting agents, risk models, and research platforms.
subnets.onboardingPublishers: Review active prediction markets and submit analysis on market mispricings, narrative-versus-odds divergences, emerging evidence, probability shifts, or likely outcomes. Focus on clear reasoning, supporting evidence, and actionable forecasting insights.
subnets.onboardingVoters: Evaluate submissions based on accuracy, evidence quality, reasoning, and forecasting rigor. Vote on whether the analysis provides credible, useful insight and helps distinguish signal from speculation.

subnets.subnetDescription: Verified streaming behavioral data contributed through Myrad. ZK-verified via Reclaim, PII-stripped, and GDPR/CCPA compliant. This datanet scores contributions on quality, completeness, and commercial value, surfacing the strongest data for AI and consumer-intelligence buyers. Note: content-preference and segmentation data is high-fidelity; temporal fields (viewing times/days) may be sparse where the source platform does not expose timestamps, evaluators help flag and score this.
subnets.onboardingPublishers: Data will be published by Myrad team.
subnets.onboardingVoters:
Each pod contains verified streaming profiles. Review the batch and vote based on the majority:

👍 Approve if most profiles are good, meaning they're ZK-verified, have real titles, genres with IAB categories, and audience segmentation populated. A few empty or thin profiles mixed in is fine as long as the batch is mostly strong.

👎 Reject if most profiles are empty, unverified, zero-title, or show inconsistent data (e.g. summary fields filled but underlying values all zero).

In short: if the majority of the batch is real, verified, and usable, approve it.

subnets.subnetDescription: Community-driven training data marketplace for autonomous AI trading agents. Features live trade data with strategy context, market regime annotations, and structured execution records across all instruments. Each pod is community-scored on training value — strategy context, verifiability, and reflection are rewarded. Raw dumps without analysis score lower. Quality beats quantity.
subnets.onboardingPublishers:
Share your trading data for training autonomous AI agents.

Include:
• Entry: market, direction, entry price, size, signal/pattern
• Exit: exit price, hold duration, outcome
• Strategy context: setup, regime classification (trending, ranging, high-vol, low-liquidity), reflection on what worked
• Verification: timestamps or tx hashes
• Format: Structured JSON/CSV preferred

Do NOT focus on: PnL, win rate, size, or trade count — these aren't scored.

Quality beats quantity. One annotated trade with strategy context is worth more than a hundred raw dumps. Clean data drives higher EVOF scores.
subnets.onboardingVoters:
Score pods on usefulness for training autonomous trading agents (1-10):

8-10 — Strategy context (setup, regime, reflection) + entry/sizing/exit. Structured format (JSON/CSV). Verifiable via tx hashes. An agent trains on this and improves.

5-7 — Entry/sizing/exit covered but no analysis layer or structured format. Verifiable but shallow. Useful feedstock.

2-4 — Gaps in data, missing verification, or vague. Low signal.

1 — Spam, empty, adversarial.

Do NOT score on: PnL, win rate, position size, trade count.

Reward: Strategy context, regime annotations, reflection, verifiability (tx hashes), structured format.

Freshness: >7 days stale caps at 7. Unusual conditions (high-vol, low-liquidity, regime shifts) retain value longer.

subnets.subnetName: DSCLabs | Strike Robot - Industrial Video Annotation for Robotic Vision
subnets.subnetDescription: We are building a high-quality dataset to train autonomous robots in factory environments. Contributors will watch video clips of industrial activities and label key events, such as assembly steps, equipment handling, and safety incidents. Your work will help robots understand and navigate complex manufacturing workflows.
subnets.onboardingPublishers: Upload high-quality video clips (MP4/MOV, minimum 720p) of workers performing manual industrial tasks. Each clip should be 10-30 seconds long and focus on a single, clear action (e.g., assembling a part, picking up a tool, or wearing safety gear). Ensure the worker's movements are clearly visible with minimal obstructions. Please avoid videos with low lighting or extreme camera shaking.
subnets.onboardingVoters: Evaluate if the video content accurately matches the provided labels and descriptions. Check if the start and end timestamps of the action are precise. Ensure the video quality is sufficient for AI training (clear visibility, correct orientation). Reject any clips that are irrelevant, poor quality, or contain sensitive personal information not related to the task.

subnets.subnetDescription:
Betsonic, built by SonicLabs on Base, turns real-stakes iGaming into behavioral data for AI and robotics by capturing how humans truly weigh risk, consequence, and reward when real money is on the line. 

It builds the decision-layer signal that low-stakes datasets miss: genuine human risk tolerance, the training data autonomous systems need to understand consequence and act safely around people.
subnets.onboardingPublishers:
Publishers contribute gameplay data from Betsonic's Original games that captures real human risk behavior.

Phase one (now): submit a video walkthrough of a single Betsonic Original a screen recording of a real play session showing bet sizing, cash-out timing, and reactions to wins and losses. One game per submission.

Requirements:
- One Betsonic Original per pod, clearly named.
- A clear, complete recording: full rounds, readable UI, no cuts that hide decisions.
- A hosted video link plus a short note on the risk decisions shown (stake size, when the player pressed or pulled back, reaction after a win or loss).

Stronger submissions show genuine, varied decision-making under real stakes not scripted or repetitive play. Contribution formats will expand as the Datanet evolves; current guidance is always posted here.
subnets.onboardingVoters:
Voters score each submission on how well it captures genuine human risk behavior.

Evaluate on:
- Clarity & completeness: full rounds visible, readable UI, no cuts hiding key decisions.
- Authenticity: real-stakes play with genuine, varied decisions not scripted, staged, or repetitive farming.
- Informativeness: clearly shows risk signals like bet sizing relative to balance, cash-out timing, reaction to wins and losses.
- Accuracy: the submission matches its description and is a genuine Betsonic Original session.

Upvote clear, authentic, information-rich contributions. Downvote low-effort, duplicated, staged, or misleading ones. Quality, not quantity, wins.

subnets.subnetDescription: A marketplace for trading strategies to be used by AI agents to trade with real money on Hyperliquid or other platforms. Strategies should be back-tested on major assets on HL (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, etc) to produce at least a 50% win rate consistently.
subnets.onboardingPublishers:
Strategies should be back-tested on major assets on Hyperliquid (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE) to produce at least a 50% win rate consistently. Submit the full prompt/instructions that would be given to the AI Agent in order to setup the strategy being specific about the timeframe used, and the entry requirements for a trade to fire. Timeframes should be for short to mid-term trading strategies (no buy and hold). Strategy timeframes accepted: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h. 

Example: Use the 15m timeframe and enter a long when the price closes above the 200 EMA after being under the 200 EMA for more than 200 completed 15m bars. Strategies could be simple or much more complex than this but should backtest to have a win rate of 50% or higher.

A win needs to have an explicit entry, target and stop, and it needs to hit the target at least 50% of the time before hitting the stop. Setups need to produce at least 1.5R to 1R in order to be accepted, meaning the Target is at least 1.5x the risk taken (stop).
subnets.onboardingVoters:
Back-test the actual prompts/strategies on major assets on Hyperliquid like BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE and evaluate if they hold up on the timeframe mentioned and produce a 50% win rate or higher over a reasonably long enough back-test period. 

By a win, it means there needs to be an explicit entry, target and stop, and it needs to hit the target at least 50% of the time before hitting the stop. Setups need to produce at least 1.5R to 1R in order to be accepted, meaning the Target is at least 1.5x the risk taken (stop) and is it at least 50% of the time. 

Strategy timeframes accepted: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h.
